text:
marisol: Heads up — after we flipped tenant-affinity routing to canary, metrics show a huge set of SLO alerts for tenant `nova-corp` b/w 02:10-03:30 UTC, ~1.8k alerts.
tobias: saw it. most seem identical SLO violation messages from the same backend shard, but each one fans out to multiple notify channels.
kiara: Confirming. notify-service v4.2 rolled 2026-03-18T02:09Z to 10% (canaries). Deploy logs show retries.
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-18T02:09Z — notify-service v4.2 -> canary
alert-bot: Pager: SLO:latency_p95 tenant:nova-corp — 1.8k events
marisol: Two asks: (1) can console surface a unique alert fingerprint and origin hint (backend id / replica / route) so we can group? (2) temporary console-level duplicate suppression toggle while we fix notify-service?
tobias: We currently only show route_id and slo_id. No stable fingerprint. The emitter attaches `instance_id` in some cases but not normalized.
kiara: Proposed API change in alert-emission: add `alert_fingerprint` (sha1 of slo_id + route_id + origin_id + minute-epoch) and `origin_hint` (string like "shard-12/replica-b")
marisol: That would let console "group by fingerprint" and collapse duplicates; also let alert routing send one page per-fingerprint.
tobias: Doable. Small change in notify-emitter and alert-ingest. Backwards compatible if we make fields optional.
ops-bot: Note: need to update docs + event schema in `events/alerts.proto` and bump kafka topic contract.
kiara: UX note: in console, add a per-SLO toggle "suppress duplicate fingerprints within X min" default 5m, and a visibility column for origin_hint. Also a quick "open sample alerts" link that shows raw payloads.
rachel: For canary rollout, we should gate printing origin_hint in prod for privacy reasons? it's mostly internal IDs.
marisol: origin_hint should be redacted in tenant-facing views. internal console can show full.
tobias: I'll open a small PR: alert-emitter: add fields, populate from emitter context. kiara can take console UI changes.
kiara: Will stub the toggle and grouping logic. For now, we can add a temporary server-side suppression at ingest: drop alerts with identical candidate fingerprint arriving within 10s.
marisol: Great. Who will coordinate rollback if suppression hides real incidents?
tobias: ops-runbook entry: if suppression drops a high cardinality group for >2min, auto-disable suppression and page SRE. I'll add that.
marisol: OK — plan: (1) ingest-level short dedupe (10s) immediate (tobias) (2) alert-emitter schema change + migration (tobias) (3) console group/suppress toggle + origin_hint column (kiara) (4) docs + event-contract bump (ops-bot) (5) postmortem + canary rollback decision if repeats (marisol)
kiara: ETA: console PR by EOD tomorrow. Tobias: can you do the ingest patch in next 2hrs?
tobias: On it, will post PR link here.
marisol: Thanks — keep messages short. I'll update oncall. :thumbsup:
